description: Repo-level exceptions to the shared preset. Each rule names the compatibility constraint it protects; remove the rule when the constraint clears.
This install must stay native-binary free and must work on Android/Termux. Any dependency that adds a platform-specific prebuilt binary is blocked from an automatic bump.

packageRules.description: Node 20 is the floor (package.json engines). Renovate must not raise it past what Termux ships.
